decisions.quote:
Xu, E (1993, March). The concept of object identity. Paper presented at the biennial meeting of
       the Society for Research in Child Development, New Orleans, LA.
decisions.reason: The current paper explicitly compares its own identity-tracking result to the two experiments in Xu1993, so this is not merely a background citation. Its raw reference identifies a March1993SRCDpresentation, but an earlier published empirical report/proceedings or exact presentation body has not been recovered. The final expert blanket exclusion of all conference presentations and claim no published version existed are unsupported; its nonliteral quote remains rejected. Original-publication investigation0137used six nonrepeating free requests for this case; parent followed the newly discovered author CV link with one additional request within the original12totalHTTP ceiling (nine total across both cases). The primary author page records PhD1995and lists the related Xu/Carey journal paper in1996; neither establishes the1993report publication status or licenses a later-paper substitution. No primary programme/proceedings/presentation/dissertation link establishing an earlier published version is supplied. Thus publication eligibility and exact original identity remain a specific actual evidence-access/publication ambiguity after attempts. Do not certify either a genuinely absent eligible pair or a categorical exclusion from this missing evidence.
